The '''WBY series''' was a series of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s programmed to instruct [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in the operation of mechanical vehicles. The [[WBY-102 FirstMate]] was a less common variant designed to teach the crewing and sailing of multi-sailed [[Boat/Legends|boats]] and [[Yacht (aquatic)/Legends|yachts]].
